project.name: kloudvestigate
project.purpose: Internal telemetry investigation, daily station auditing, and publication-material preparation tool for KloudTrack station data.
project.framework: Next.js 16.2.6 App Router with React 19.2.4 and TypeScript.
project.summary: Use this file as the compact project map for future work. The app has server-rendered App Router pages, focused client dashboards, route-handler APIs as the backend-for-frontend layer, server-only KloudTrack access, deterministic telemetry analysis, persisted daily station audits, tagged audit-report caching, and demo data fallback when upstream credentials are missing.

client: app/(protected)/layout.tsx verifies the internal access cookie before rendering protected app pages.
app/(protected)/page.tsx, app/(protected)/pubmat/page.tsx, and app/(protected)/audit/page.tsx render the main dashboard, publication workflow, and audit calendar.
components/telemetry/* contains client dashboards, forms, tables, charts, and station aggregate workflows.
components/audit/AuditCalendarWorkspace.tsx owns monthly calendar navigation, cached station summaries, manual rebuild progress, and lazy audit-log loading.
components/architecture/MermaidDiagram.tsx is the browser-only Mermaid renderer used by the architecture page.
server: App Router pages are Server Components by default unless a child component declares use client.
app/api/investigations/route.ts handles investigation runs and cache lookups.
app/api/pubmat-quick-fetch/route.ts fetches station buckets for publication tables.
app/api/stations/route.ts returns station metadata from KloudTrack or demo data.
app/api/audit-reports/route.ts serves cached monthly summaries and daily audit details; app/api/audit-reports/run/route.ts streams manual rebuild progress.
Cron routes run daily station investigations and enforce audit-log retention, while Prisma persists DailyStationSummary and StationAuditLog records.

majorModules.name: Telemetry UI
majorModules.responsibility: Owns operator controls, quick fetch UX, fetched values tables, summaries, events, and visualization panels.

majorModules.name: KloudTrack API adapter
majorModules.responsibility: Keeps x-kloudtrack-key server-side, resolves metric history endpoints, fetches dashboard/history data, and normalizes upstream responses.

majorModules.name: Telemetry analysis
majorModules.responsibility: Computes deterministic summaries, interval buckets, gaps, duplicates, spikes, flatlines, threshold crossings, range violations, and metric metadata.

majorModules.name: Investigation cache
majorModules.responsibility: Stores recent deterministic investigation payloads in memory for batch lookup and dashboard hydration.

majorModules.name: Audit workspace
majorModules.responsibility: Presents the monthly audit calendar, reuses monthly station summaries for instant date navigation, streams rebuild progress, and loads detailed audit logs only on demand.

majorModules.name: Daily audit pipeline
majorModules.responsibility: Runs station investigations for a Philippine calendar day and transactionally replaces or creates persisted station summaries and audit-log rows.

majorModules.name: Audit report cache
majorModules.responsibility: Caches month, date, station, and detail-specific audit payloads for five minutes and immediately expires affected date/month tags after successful writes.

majorModules.name: Audit persistence and retention
majorModules.responsibility: Stores daily station summaries and related audit logs in PostgreSQL and removes audit-log details outside the current Philippine month.

security: INTERNAL_ACCESS_TOKEN acts as the shared internal password and signs the httpOnly access cookie.
assertInternalAccess accepts the signed cookie or legacy Bearer/x-internal-access-token headers for route-handler APIs.
KloudTrack API keys are read only in server modules and route handlers.
writeAuditEvent currently emits structured audit JSON to console.
Production must configure INTERNAL_ACCESS_TOKEN; missing configuration returns setup errors instead of allowing public access.
dataFlow: Operator selects station, metric, time range, and interval.
Client component POSTs to an App Router route handler.
Route handler validates internal access and request shape.
Server loads telemetry from KloudTrack or demo data.
Normalizer converts upstream payloads into typed station and telemetry records.
Deterministic analysis creates summaries, anomalies, interval buckets, and record tables.
Client renders tables, charts, events, and status summaries.

diagrams.title: Server Architecture
diagrams.description: Route handlers form a backend-for-frontend layer around authentication, upstream data access, deterministic analysis, caching, and audit logging.
diagrams.mermaid:
flowchart LR
  Client[Client dashboards] -->|GET/POST| Routes[Next App Router route handlers]
  Routes --> Auth[assertInternalAccess]
  Auth --> Loader[Telemetry loaders]
  Loader --> Demo[Demo telemetry fallback]
  Loader --> Kloud[KloudTrack API adapter]
  Kloud --> Normalize[Normalize station and telemetry records]
  Demo --> Normalize
  Normalize --> Analyze[Deterministic analysis]
  Analyze --> Cache[Investigation cache]
  Analyze --> Response[JSON response]
  Cache --> Response
  Analyze --> Audit[Structured audit log]

diagrams.title: Audit Architecture
diagrams.description: Monthly summary reads and daily audit details are cached separately, while manual and scheduled rebuilds persist results and immediately invalidate affected cache tags.
diagrams.mermaid:
flowchart LR
  AuditUI[AuditCalendarWorkspace] -->|Monthly summaries or daily details| Reports["GET /api/audit-reports"]
  Reports --> ReportCache[Tagged audit report cache]
  ReportCache --> Database[(PostgreSQL via Prisma)]
  AuditUI -->|Manual rebuild| Run["POST /api/audit-reports/run"]
  DailyCron[Daily investigation cron] --> Runner[Daily station investigations]
  Run --> Runner
  Runner --> Investigation["POST /api/investigations"]
  Investigation --> Analysis[Deterministic telemetry analysis]
  Analysis --> Runner
  Runner -->|Transactional summaries and logs| Database
  Runner -->|Expire date and month tags| ReportCache
  Retention[Audit log retention cron] -->|Delete logs outside current PHT month| Database
  Retention -->|Expire all audit tags after deletion| ReportCache

diagrams.title: Response Strategy
diagrams.description: The investigation API returns deterministic findings and chart/table data directly to the UI.
diagrams.mermaid:
sequenceDiagram
  participant Operator
  participant Client
  participant API as Route Handler
  participant Loader as Telemetry Loader
  participant Analysis as Deterministic Analysis
  Operator->>Client: Run investigation
  Client->>API: Send selection
  API->>Loader: Load normalized telemetry
  Loader-->>API: Station and records
  API->>Analysis: Analyze selected metric series
  Analysis-->>API: Summaries, events, intervals
  API-->>Client: JSON investigation payload

environment: KLOUDTRACK_API_TOKEN enables real upstream telemetry; absence uses demo data in current flows.
BETA_KLOUDTRACK_API_TOKEN enables the beta KloudTrack environment.
INTERNAL_ACCESS_TOKEN enables the shared login gate, signs the internal access cookie, and guards APIs when configured or in production.
